summary: GMF Leasing LLC, as depositor, and AmeriCredit Financial Services (GM Financial), as sponsor, formed a new issuing entity, GM Financial Automobile Leasing Trust 2026-2, which issued multiple tranches of asset-backed notes totaling $1.25 billion (Class A-1 through C notes) and a certificate, on May 14, 2026. This 8-K is a routine takedown from an existing shelf registration statement (333-285619) to satisfy an undertaking to file validity and tax opinions from Katten Muchin Rosenman LLP. There are no special-situation elements such as an acquisition, divestiture, going-private, or restructuring. The filing is a standard ABS issuance with no change of control or strategic event.
